orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Manoj Kumar Tiwari
orders.text:
CLR No. 72 of 2018 
Hon’ble Manoj K. Tiwari, J.
Mr. Aditya Singh, Advocate 
present for the revisionist. 
Heard. 
Mr. I.P. Kohli, Advocate submits 
that he has been telephonically 
instructed by respondent to appear on 
his behalf in this case. He undertakes 
to file Vakalatnama in the Registry 
within a week. 
In the interest of justice, the 
matter is adjourned for today. 
List this matter on 28.08.2018. 
Meanwhile, Mr. I.P. Kohli, learned 
counsel for the respondent shall file 
counter affidavit. 
Interim order dated 03.07.2018 
is extended till the next date of listing. [ 
 (Manoj K. Tiwari, J.) 31.07.2018 Neha

orders.judge: Hon'ble Mr. Justice Lok Pal Singh
orders.text:
CLR No. 72 of 2018 
Hon’ble Lok Pal Singh, J.
Mr. Aditya Singh, Advocate for the 
revisionist. 
 Mr. I.P. Kohli, Advocate for respondent. 
 Heard. 
 Learned counsel for the parties apprised 
this Court that in regard to the same 
disputed property, the First Appeal No. 13 of 
2018 titled as M/s Dixon Technologies India 
Ltd. Vs. M/s Allied Photographic India Ltd. 
and others is pending before another bench 
of this Court. 
 In view of the above, this Court is of the 
view that the matter be placed before Hon’ble 
the Chief Justice for obtaining appropriate 
directions. 
 Registry is directed to place the matter 
before Hon’ble the Chief Justice for obtaining 
necessary directions/orders.
(Lok Pal Singh, J.) 
 10.10.2019 Mamta
